commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot from Duke to Bot67
Add support to todos, deadlines and events
Implement level-6 task deletion with ArrayList
Implement Level 8 date and time support

commitResults.messageBody: Move Bot67 startup, shutdown, separator, and error-output responsibilities into a dedicated Ui class. Keep command parsing and task operations unchanged so this incremental refactor preserves existing behavior while reducing the main class's UI responsibilities.

Move task collection ownership and add, delete, mark, unmark, lookup, and size operations out of Bot67. Keep persistence access through a read-only list view so command behavior and saved task formats remain unchanged.

Move task-number parsing and todo, deadline, and event validation out of Bot67 into a dedicated Parser class. Preserve existing error messages and Level-8 date handling while reducing command interpretation responsibilities in the main class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract exit behavior into a command object
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce the abstract Command contract and implement ExitCommand for the bye command. Extend Parser to create the exit command and update Bot67 to execute it, establishing the command-object structure while preserving all existing non-exit command handling.

Configure Gradle for Java 25 builds and tests.
Set Bot67 as the application entry point.
Cover task lifecycle, task collections, date parsing, command validation, exit handling, and user interface output to protect core behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JavaDoc comments to public APIs
commitResults.messageBody:
Document public classes, constructors, methods, and non-trivial
helpers to improve the generated API documentation.
Fix source formatting, import ordering, and unused variables to improve consistency and readability.
Allow users to search task descriptions by keyword and display matching tasks with their original list numbers.

commitResults.messageTitle: Configure Checkstyle for automated style validation
commitResults.messageBody: Add the SE-EDU Checkstyle rules and Gradle integration so style violations can be detected consistently. Fix existing indentation, spacing, and import-order violations, and ignore runtime task data to keep generated user content out of version control.

commitResults.messageTitle: Set up JavaFX application entry point
commitResults.messageBody: Add the cross-platform JavaFX dependencies and a separate launcher so the GUI can run reliably from both Gradle and the packaged JAR.

commitResults.messageTitle: Build FXML chat interface for Bot67
commitResults.messageBody: Connect the existing command and storage logic to a responsive JavaFX chat window so the GUI retains all text-UI behavior. Style the interface with the supplied Bot67, user, and background assets while keeping the console interface testable.
Add a consistent gap between each speaker image and its message bubble so the chat layout is easier to read.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use varargs for displaying multiple UI messages
commitResults.messageBody: Allow Ui.showLine to receive multiple messages and print them in order. This reduces repeated calls when constructing multi-line responses while preserving existing application behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use assertions to enforce task-list invariants
commitResults.messageBody: TaskList relies on callers to provide non-null tasks and valid one-based positions. Make these internal contracts explicit so programming errors fail close to their source, and verify mutation postconditions after adding or deleting tasks. Enable assertions for Gradle application runs and cover invalid internal calls in unit tests.
Use assertions to enforce task-list invariants

Bot67.execute previously combined command parsing, dispatch, and error handling in one long conditional chain. Extract the task-command dispatch and incomplete-command validation into focused helper methods so each method has a clearer responsibility while preserving existing behavior.
Branch a code quality

commitResults.messageTitle: Use streams for numbered task displays
commitResults.messageBody:
The list and find operations previously used imperative loops to
format and display numbered tasks.

Replace them with IntStream pipelines to make each transformation
clear while preserving one-based numbering and command behavior.
Use streams for numbered task displays

Users previously had to keep tasks in insertion order, which made longer lists harder to scan.

Add a sort command that orders task descriptions case-insensitively and persists the new order. Document the command and cover it with unit and end-to-end UI tests.
Add alphabetical task sorting

Boolean fields should read clearly as predicates at each use site.
Rename the affected fields with is or has prefixes to follow the
Java naming convention without changing application behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve chat layout and command guidance for easier task management
commitResults.messageBody: Add responsive message widths, a collapsible command guide, error emphasis, and empty-input and empty-list feedback so users can navigate commands more comfortably.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restore the pink theme and improve guide and avatar readability
commitResults.messageBody: Reuse the hearts background beneath a pale overlay, enlarge rounded chat avatars, and show the bot picture in the header. Left-align and enlarge guide text with a bounded scroll area that keeps input accessible in smaller windows.

commitResults.messageTitle: Render personality art reliably and clarify command formats
commitResults.messageBody: Draw the original Braille dot patterns in the welcome message without relying on font support. Document each command on its own line with placeholders, date formats, and spacing instructions so users can compose valid commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use Bot67's profile picture as the application window icon
commitResults.messageBody: Set the JavaFX stage icon to the existing bot image so the window is easier to recognize and matches the chat identity.
Improve Bot67 GUI readability and command guidance

commitResults.messageTitle: Enhance Bot67 replies while preserving his six-seven personality
commitResults.messageBody: Share greeting and farewell wording across interfaces, add encouraging task-specific replies and explicit empty states, and keep task counts readable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document personality replies and verify friendly recovery flows
commitResults.messageBody: Refresh response checkpoints and cover empty lists, missing search results, task status feedback, error recovery, and the original farewell.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep a single introduction in sorted task replies
commitResults.messageBody: Render task rows separately from the list introduction so sort retains only its own personality line. Update the UI test plan for populated and empty lists.
Branch a personality

commitResults.messageTitle: Validate commands before changing task data
commitResults.messageBody:
Normalize command whitespace and provide usage guidance for missing or extra arguments. Reject repeated date parameters, unsafe record separators, impossible dates, and non-increasing ISO event ranges so malformed input cannot become saved tasks.

Validate task numbers against the current list instead of a fixed limit of 100. Preserve free-form dates and duplicate tasks, document the rules, and cover recovery with parser tests and 15 console scenarios.

commitResults.messageTitle: Protect saved tasks when loading or writing fails
commitResults.messageBody:
Reject damaged save records with a line number and show startup warnings in both interfaces. Disable changes after a load failure so unreadable or malformed data cannot be silently replaced with an empty list.

Write complete temporary files before atomic replacement and roll back failed adds, status changes, deletions, and sorting. Explain recovery in the user guide and verify persistence, failure recovery, 18 console scenarios, and JavaFX warning display with Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restore the original ASCII banner in the GUI welcome
commitResults.messageBody:
The console still printed BANNER, but the GUI only showed the separate personality artwork. Reuse the original banner in a monospace text node above the artwork and greeting so its lettering remains aligned.

Verify the banner fits at 420px and 640px, retain the existing artwork, and document the graphical checks. All 18 console scenarios, 27 unit tests, Checkstyle, and the JavaFX smoke check pass on Java 25.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove the extra heading from GUI error replies
commitResults.messageBody: Show command errors and startup warnings directly, as requested, while retaining their contrasting error colors. Update the GUI test plan to expect the response text without an added heading.
Branch a more error handling

commitResults.messageTitle: Add integration tests for Bot67 command workflows
commitResults.messageBody: Exercise successful task operations, search and sorting behavior, command-specific errors, persistence, and recovery through Bot67's public response API.
Add integration tests for Bot67 command workflows

commitResults.messageTitle: Finalize Bot67 naming and release documentation
commitResults.messageBody: Replace remaining user-facing Duke names, migrate saved tasks safely to the Bot67 path, document all commands and recovery behavior, and record project and asset credits before release.
Finalize Bot67 naming and release documentation

commitResults.messageTitle: Set up the Bot67 product website
commitResults.messageBody: Add the representative full-window GUI screenshot to the User Guide and restore detailed IntelliJ setup instructions so contributors can configure Java 25 correctly.
Document every command with formats, examples, outcomes, task numbering behavior, date rules, saved-data handling, and practical recovery steps for common problems.
Explain prerequisites, Gradle import, Java 25 configuration, application startup, automated checks, and common fixes so a new contributor can run Bot67 reliably.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refine Bot67 documentation for first-time users
commitResults.messageBody:
Add installation, a first-task walkthrough, search semantics, backup guidance, and troubleshooting so users can confidently use every supported command.

Align developer setup, project context, credits, and UI test instructions with the current codebase while preserving template attribution and legacy storage documentation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document confirmed permission to reuse GUI images
commitResults.messageBody: Replace the unverified-permission wording with the project author's confirmation of owner permission and open licensing. Keep the credits explicit that specific source and licence details are not recorded.
